name: crowdfunding-subgraph
description: The Graph subgraph indexing the Crowdfunding DApp events

scripts.build: npm run configure:sepolia && graph codegen && graph build
scripts.deploy:local: npm run configure:local && graph deploy --node http://localhost:8020/ --ipfs http://localhost:5001 crowdfunding-platform
scripts.deploy:studio: npm run build && graph deploy --studio crowdfunding-platform
